notes: I found the rule: the box applies `str.capitalize()` to the original string (first character uppercased if a letter, all others lowercased), then removes spaces. This explains the surprising `" Zebralower" -> "zebralower"` (leading space becomes the "first char" so nothing gets uppercased, and the rest is lowercased) while `"Hello World function lazy" -> "Helloworldfunctionlazy"` keeps the capital
